title: Modern web types
description: An exploration of TypeScript's API coverage gaps and practical solutions helps developers navigate type safety for cutting-edge web standards. This bridges the gap between evolving JavaScript APIs and tooling support.

title: Aperture
description: An AI code editor that verifies its own output represents a significant shift in developer tooling—reducing manual code review overhead while improving reliability. This addresses a critical pain point for engineering teams and could influence how future AI-assisted development tools are designed.

title: Sellio
description: AI-powered customer support agents consolidated into a shared inbox streamline team workflows and reduce response times without fragmented systems. This demonstrates practical AI agent deployment in a high-impact customer-facing application.

title: LaunchReel
description: Bringing Claude-style AI design to video editing dramatically accelerates professional content creation, similar to how AI transformed UI design workflows. This unlocks video production for teams without specialized editing expertise.

title: Smooth Recorder
description: Automatically polished Mac screen recordings eliminate post-production editing friction, enabling faster documentation and tutorial creation. This solves a common UX friction point for creators sharing demos and walkthroughs.

title: Pass Designer
description: A visual designer for Apple Wallet passes with real-time preview democratizes mobile payment and ticket design for developers and designers. This enables more engaging digital pass experiences without complex backend integration.

title: Thinking Orbs
description: A React component library for animated AI status indicators provides reusable, polished patterns for communicating AI processing states. This addresses a growing design need as AI features become standard in applications.

title: Reassign
description: A narrative-driven planner designed specifically for makers reimagines task management by connecting daily work to creative identity and storytelling. This represents a fresh approach to productivity tooling that resonates with creative professionals.
